findings.title: Reconnect path may leave stale session state
findings.evidence: Old session cleanup is not guaranteed before reconnect branch returns success.
findings.impact: Subsequent reconnect attempts may operate on inconsistent session state.
findings.recommendation: Ensure deterministic cleanup before starting a new reconnect attempt.

findings.title: LCP echo retry count không reset sau reconnect
findings.evidence: Biến retry_count vẫn giữ giá trị cũ từ session trước.
findings.impact: Session mới có thể fail sớm hơn mong đợi sau WAN flap.
findings.recommendation: Reset retry_count = 0 trong lcp_init() khi reconnect.
